pages.text: $(bold)Iron Doors, Trapdoors, and Fence Gates$() open only on a signal (wood ones can also be clicked). $(bold)TNT$() primes when powered — the loud actuator.
pages.title: Doors & TNT

pages.text: $(italic)Tinkers' Construct$() adds the $(bold)Seared$() and $(bold)Scorched Fluid Cannons$(): point them, power them, and they fire a jet of whatever fluid they hold. Smeltery plumbing meets redstone.
pages.title: Fluid Cannons
